notes.title: The final classic level update is here!
notes.content:
This update concludes adding classic JellyCar levels into JellyCar Worlds.
Over 60 levels from JellyCar 3 have been added in this update, complete with secret exits and challenges.
This update also adds options to customize car abilities in custom levels.

notes.title: Time travel to Classic Levels & Editor Improvements
notes.content:
New in this version:

Classic levels (restored level from JellyCar 1) added.

Level Editor improvements:
[list]
[*] Falling custom objects are now possible.
[*] Conveyor belts added.
[*] Laser detectors added.
[*] Checkpoints added.
[/list]

notes.title: Custom Levels have arrived!
notes.content:
New in this version:
- Level Editor! You can now create and play your own custom levels with a powerful custom level editor.
- Many bug fixes and optimizations

notes.title: Racing to finish the Worlds Adventure!
notes.content:
New in this version:
- Added World 8 (the final adventure world) featuring the "turbo" ability
- Added a custom music playlist feature
- Added "Level Rush" for creating custom multi-level race challenges
- Added "Skull Rush" for the ultimate challenge
- Many bug fixes and optimizations

notes.title: Swinging into World 7!
notes.content:
[h2]New in this version[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added World 7 featuring the grapple ability
[*] Can now access challenges from Level Complete and other menus
[*] Added On-screen Button control option for iOS
[*] Improved UI for sound recorder
[*] More options when resetting progress such as keeping your car design and best time ghosts
[*] Many bug fixes and optimizations
[/list]
